requirements.description: User wants energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area, capacity, Turin location and proximity to parks are not energy requirements and are not included.

The user wants the unit located near parks. Parks and green areas are explicitly requested, so the green category is activated. The value is set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74, because the user expresses nearness to parks.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to surface_area.

Results are ordered by distance to the coordinates ascending. No LIMIT applied.
